name: Scylla and Charybdis Will
beast: Scylla and Charybdis, the Strait Pair

abilities.name: Rock Snatch
abilities.effect: A short darting lunge along the cliff edge, a head-shaped streak snapping ahead.

acquire.equipPiece: A single stone-grey cliff pauldron with a carved snarling dog-head on one shoulder (the only equipped piece).

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form: the whole body becomes a strait-humanoid in cliff-stone armor: six dog-head shoulder guards that snap on thin necks, stone-grey plates on chest and arms, clawed hands, wave-scale teal plating on the lower body, digitigrade legs and a short fin-tail; a spear of stone and whirlpool water forms in the hand.

equip.weapon: A long barnacled spear of stone and whirlpool water, with a spinning teal vortex around its head.
equip.armor: Stone-grey cliff plates on chest and arms, six dog-head shoulder guards (drawn as three twin-head quads), teal wave-scale plating on the lower body.
equip.hair_eyes: Sea-green wet hair streaming back, red glowing eyes.
equip.aura: Teal spray with a small swirling vortex at the feet.

beastNote: Scylla and Charybdis, the Strait Pair
lore: On opposite sides of the narrow strait: Scylla with six snapping dog heads on the cliff, Charybdis the whirlpool beneath.
pitch: Scylla and Charybdis are the strait pair of Greek myth: six snapping dog heads on the cliff and a ship-eating whirlpool below. Acquire keeps you human, darting in teal streaks with one dog-head cliff pauldron. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a stone-armored, six-headed beastman with a whirlpool spear, and costs a medium-high drain because the two halves pull against each other.
untrained: An untrained holder is torn two ways: the heads snap at the holder's own shoulders, the whirlpool drags at the legs and strain builds whenever both halves act together. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

spirit.echo: A rocky six-headed beastman in cliff armor: stone-grey plates, six snapping dog heads on thin necks from the shoulders (three twin-head quads), teal wave-scale lower body, a whirlpool spear.
spirit.look: A grey rock orb split in half: one side jagged with six tiny snarling heads, the other a spinning teal whirlpool.
